 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u076/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f1d7524e.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width/height lines are the grid separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def regions(size, separators):
        cuts = [-1] + separators + [size]
        return [(cuts[i] + 1, cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cuts) - 1)
                if cuts[i] + 1 < cuts[i + 1]]

    row_regions = regions(h, sep_rows)
    col_regions = regions(w, sep_cols)
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_regions:
        line = []
        for c0, c1 in col_regions:
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            # The local background is the most frequent color in a cell.
            colors = sorted(set(vals))
            background = max(colors, key=lambda color: (vals.count(color), -color))
            marked = sum(v != background for v in vals)
            line.append(1 if marked == 2 else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
